_backfill_note: Historical reconstruction on 2026-05-15. Friday — three load-bearing stories close W16. (1) Anthropic launches Claude Design as research preview — prompt-to-visual-deliverable across presentations/websites/prototypes/mockups/brand-videos/landing-pages/apps; powered by Opus 4.7's 3× vision uplift; ingests team's codebase + design files; exports to PDF/URL/PPTX/Canva; priced inside Pro/Max/Team/Enterprise — most ambitious horizontal-creative play from a frontier lab to date and a deliberate run at Figma + Canva; spawns new dedicated topic 'claude-design-product'. (2) Cerebras files S-1 for ~$23B IPO on Nasdaq under 'CBRS' — $510M 2025 revenue, $20B+ Master Relationship Agreement with OpenAI for 750 MW inference capacity expandable to 2 GW, binding term sheet with AWS to integrate CS-3 hardware into Bedrock; Morgan Stanley/Citi/Barclays/UBS joint lead; single largest customer-disclosure on a US AI-IPO S-1 to date. (3) xAI quietly drops Grok 4.3 Beta — long-context + native multimodal video + in-chat slide generation + standalone STT/TTS APIs + XChat encrypted messenger on App Store, gated behind $300/mo SuperGrok Heavy; full rollout mid-to-late May. (4) Cloudflare Agents Week wraps with 20+ launches across compute/dev tools/inference/security/memory — most cohesive single-week vendor push for an end-to-end 'agent OS' to date. (5) Red Hat Friday Five names the defender stack — CIO inventory imperative + Mythos AI-driven triage + open-source-anchored hardware-agnostic AI stack — editorial groundwork for Red Hat AI 3.x + Summit/Think 2026. Research: Dive into Claude Code architectural anatomy, UniDoc-RL coarse-to-fine visual RAG, Don't-Retrieve-Navigate Corpus2Skill, DR^3-Eval deep-research realism, RAD-2 generator-discriminator RL, LongAct intrinsic-activation long-context RL, TRACER cost-aware routing, KV Packet recomputation-free caching. Blogs: Willison PyCon US 2026 PSF director dispatch; datasette 1.0a28 hotfix; Astasia Myers (Memory Leak) + Matt Turck (FirstMark) post same-day Cerebras S-1 teardowns. STAGE MOVES: claude-design-product (new) → emerging.
